en.basel-kadem: 1.	I was told by Muhammed bin Ali Majilawayh, may Allah grant him mercy, from his paternal uncle, Muhammed bin Abi’l-Qasem, from Muhammed bin Ali al-Qurashi, from Hussain bin Sufyan al-Jareeri, from Salam bin Abi ‘Umra al-Azdi, from Ma’ruf ibn Khazbour, from Abu’t-Tufayl, that he heard the Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, say:

Indeed, after me will be darkening, blind, doubt-causing, tribulations in which none will remain except for the sleeper. It was said: O Commander of the Believers, and what is a sleeper? He said: The one about whom people do not know what is in.
